Commentary.Commentary: We are all set for the chase. The Lankan players are out in the middle. Imam-ul-Haq and Abdullah Shafique are the openers for Pakistan. Kasun Rajitha to start with the ball.
...Fourth Innings...

The recent form of Dinesh Chandimal indicates he is at peak of his career. Played some brilliant innings against the Aussies recently. He showed his class in the first innings and now here again with the tail-enders have produced a big result. Kusal Mendis and Oshada Fernando gave a good start for Sri Lanka but once they both fell. Dinesh Chandimal played his part along with the lower order. Dhananjaya de Silva and Ramesh Mendis played a small cameo while the tail gave the much needed support to Chandimal. The batters have done the job and the bowlers need to rise to the occasion. Talking about Pakistan, they did well to bundle the hosts out early but would have loved to end their innings on Day 3 itself. The bowlers had hard work to do and a couple of partnerships at the front and failing to clear the tail has left an uphill task for them. They missed Shaheen Afridi who would have been valuable in cleaning the lower order. Mohammad Nawaz grabbed five wickets while Yasir Shah ended with three. Now, the Pakistani batters have a huge score in front of them. The time will not be an issue but they need to show some determination against a bunch of spinners. Stay tuned as we will be back after the break.

Dinesh Chandimal is stranded on 94 as his partner finally lets one through. What an innings yet again though from Chandimal! He has been in the form of his life. Yet again a likely match winning score from him. So, just 8 runs added to the overnight lead. Pakistan have an uphill task as they need 342 runs to win.

OUT! TIMBER! Prabath Jayasuriya can not keep the last ball out! Dinesh Chandimal is left stranded on 94! Naseem Shah goes on a good length and pitches this on middle, the ball straightens a fraction after pitching. Prabath Jayasuriya looks to defend the line of the delivery and the ball goes past his outside edge to shatter the stumps. Sri Lanka have set a target of 342 runs! Spare a thought for Dinesh Chandimal who has played mangnificiently and his performace may well have defined this match!
Full outside off, Dinesh Chandimal gets an easy single to deep cover as the field is still back. Prabath Jayasuriya has just one ball to face now.
Naseem Shah goes a touch fuller outside off, Dinesh Chandimal defends this, and the ball rolls to deep cover as the field is back.
This is on a good length and just outside off, Dinesh Chandimal defends this solidly back to the bowler.
Good-length delivery once more and angling in from outside off, Dinesh Chandimal looks to work this leg side and gets a leading edge to wide third man.
Naseem Shah delivers this on a good length outside off, Dinesh Chandimal strokes this towards long on and stays at the crease.

Hasan Ali serves a yorker aimed for the off pole. Prabath Jayasuriya gets his bat down in time and does well to dig the ball out. Survives another ball and Dinesh Chandimal will get to keep strike for the next over.
Hasan Ali goes full once again outside off. Dinesh Chandimal knocks this to long on for an easy single. Pakistan had still kept the field back for some reason.
This is full outside off, Dinesh Chandimal taps this towards cover but there is no brace so he refuses the single.
Hasan Ali goes slightly full and outside off, Dinesh Chandimal tries to force a shot and hits this uppishly towards long on. Does not get good timing on this.
On a good length, outside off. Dinesh Chandimal guides this towards third man and stays on strike.
Hasan Ali starts with a short delivery outside off, Dinesh Chandimal pulls the ball towards deep mid-wicket and does not take a single.
Naseem Shah goes outside off and on a good length. Prabath Jayasuriya hangs his bat out to dry and gets beaten on the outside edge.
This is a fraction full and aimed for the stumps, Prabath Jayasuriya solidly behind this one as he knocks it to mid on.
This is on a good length outside off, Dinesh Chandimal guides it to deep backward point and takes a single this time.

Great running from the batters! Naseem Shah goes for a good-length delivery outside off, Dinesh Chandimal taps this with soft hands towards backward point and they rush for a couple of runs. Good pressure on the fielder as a misfield allows them an easy brace.
This one is full and outside off, Dinesh Chandimal strokes this to long off and refuses a single.
Naseem Shah serves this on a good length outside off, Dinesh Chandimal looks to cut but the ball is too close. Mistimes it to the point fielder.

Naseem Shah to bowl from the other end. Shaheen Afridi clearly is not available for Pakistan. He was struggling with his right knee and an ice pack was seen strapped as well. A big miss for the tourist.
This one is in line with the stumps and on a good length. Prabath Jayasuriya defends this solidly down the pitch.
Hasan Ali goes full outside off, Prabath Jayasuriya goes for the expansive drive and misses.
Bangs this in short and outside off, Dinesh Chandimal gets on top of this and pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
On a good length once again on off, Dinesh Chandimal defends this back to Hasan Ali.

Angles this one into the pads from a good length. Dinesh Chandimal clips this through mid-wicket for a brace. Prabath Jayasuriya is struggling and the throw is good. Unfortunately, Hasan Ali has knocked the bail off before the ball reaches his hands. There was one bail still on the stumps but he could not collect the ball cleanly. A chance goes begging early on.
Hasan Ali begins with a full delivery just outside off, Dinesh Chandimal fends it back to the bowler.
We are all set for Day 4. Sri Lanka lead by 333 runs. The players are out in the middle. Dinesh Chandimal and Prabath Jayasuriya are the overnight batters. Hasan Ali to start with the ball.

Dinesh Chandimal is up for a chat. He says this is his best time playing cricket for Sri Lanka. Says that if the performance leads to a Sri Lanka win, it is even better. Claims that once players go past 30 they mature as a batter and says he capitalized on that. Admits that he has gone through a lot and things have been difficult but says he has worked hard on his game and fitness and that will always reap rewards. Confirms that it is a difficult wicket even if they get set, they can not make a big score. Says that they can't be defensive and need to be proactive every game. Batting the way he batted in the ODI series and says it seems to be working here.

PITCH REPORT - Russel Arnold is near the pitch. Says that the ball will turn and bounce and Sri Lanka will bowl wear and tear. Adds that when the trajectory is high, the batters need to come on the front foot which is a good thing as the ball skids on and can help them to survive.

Pakistan would have loved to bundle out Sri Lanka on Day 3 itself but they failed to take the last wicket. They know it is a matter of time before they wrap up the innings but they need to make sure they don’t leak many runs as Sri Lanka clearly will come with a counterattacking approach. They will have half a mind on chasing the target which is already steep but they need to primarily focus on taking this last wicket. Pakistan dug their own grave on Day 3 by conceding far too many easy runs. Can Sri Lanka put the final nail in the coffin and seal this win? Or will Pakistan claw themselves back into the tie as they already have done once in this match? Let us find out. Stay tuned for further updates

Sri Lanka are in a pole position as we head for the action on Day 4. They still have one wicket left and more importantly have Dinesh Chandimal out there batting in the form of his life. The hosts will love to add another 20-30 runs to the lead and take the game well and truly away from Pakistan. In circumspect, they will feel the target is enough, knowing the pitch is aiding the spinners and they have an arsenal of spinners in their ranks. On that note, hello and welcome to the coverage.
... Day 4, Session 1 ...

Pakistani bowlers improved session by session but the job is not done yet. If they had been accurate with the ball from the start, they could have easily kept Sri Lanka away from the 300 mark. The poor start saw them let a stand build and once again they are finding it hard to get Chandimal's wicket. The Pakistan bowlers have been unable to wrap up the tail in both innings. It was Maheesh Theekshana and Kasun Rajitha in the first innings and now Prabath Jayasuriya is standing like a rock in front of them. Pakistan will hope to take this last wicket quickly on Day 4 and then focus on the target. Join us for Day 4 at 10 am IST (4.30 am GMT) and join us early on for the build up. Till then, Cheers!

Babar Azam is getting a taste of his own medicine. He batted beautifully and maneuvered with the tail enders and now it is Chandimal who is doing the same for his team. Sri Lanka batted the whole day. They dominated the proceedings thanks to the partnership of 91 runs between Kusal Mendis and Oshada Fernando. Once both of them fell, the hosts were losing their grip on the driving seat but it was once again Dinesh Chandimal who came to the rescue. He batted brilliantly with the lower order and is now playing fantastically with just one wicket left in the kitty. The duo have added 21 runs already but Chandimal will love to take the lead past 350.

The light is not good enough and the umpire asks the players to leave the field. Stumps on Day 3. What a day for Sri Lanka! They now lead by 333 runs. They will certainly be the happier team at the end of the day! Dinesh Chandimal yet again cashing in with runs along with the tail-enders. Just the way it happened in the first innings!

FOUR! Prabath Jayasuriya gets off the mark with a boundary. This is short and drifting down the leg, Prabath Jayasuriya clears his back leg and smears it over square leg towards the deep square fence for a boundary. And just like Day 2 the umpires calls for STUMPS on Day 3 due to bad light.
This is full and on off, Prabath Jayasuriya leans on and defends it to the off side.
On middle, blocked out.
Floated on middle, Prabath Jayasuriya blocks it out from his front foot to the off side.
Tossed up on off, spinning away sharply, Prabath Jayasuriya lets it go to the keeper.

Almost for Yasir Shah. This is flighted on middle, Prabath Jayasuriya goes for the defense but plays down the wrong line. He manages to get an inside edge onto his pads. This saves him from being LBW.
The light meter is out. The groundstaff are getting ready as well.
This is short and on middle, Dinesh Chandimal pulls it hard towards leg side. The fielder at short mid-wicket dives to his right and saves the single.
It has gone very dark out there.
This is full and down the leg, Dinesh Chandimal tries to tuck it to the leg side but only manages to hit it to the keeper. He will look for the single on the last ball.
Slower ball again, on a length and on middle, Dinesh Chandimal pushes it to covers.
Bowls it short and on leg, Dinesh Chandimal pulls it to deep square leg.
Full and outside off, Dinesh Chandimal drives it through extra cover but refuses the single.
Starts with a slower ball on leg, Dinesh Chandimal pushes it towards long on. He thinks about the run but decides against it.
Flatter and quicker, drifting down the leg, Prabath Jayasuriya misses his flick and gets hit on his pads.
Flighted delivery on off, Prabath Jayasuriya guides it to point from his front foot.
Tossed up on off, Dinesh Chandimal works it through covers for a single.
FOUR! UNORTHODOX! This is full and on middle, Dinesh Chandimal picks up the length early and reverse sweeps it towards deep backward point fence for a boundary.
Swing and a miss! This is floated on off, turning away. Dinesh Chandimal goes for the big shot but misses it completely.

Good running there. This tossed up on middle, Dinesh Chandimal drives it with soft hands through covers for a brace. Prabath Jayasuriya would have been in trouble if the throw was good at the non-striker's end.
Poor from Hasan Ali. He bowls it way outside off, on a length, Prabath Jayasuriya is not interested in playing that.
BEATEN! This is a good-length delivery on off, shaping away a bit. Prabath Jayasuriya goes to block it but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Prabath Jayasuriya stands firm. This is full again on middle and leg, Prabath Jayasuriya knocks it to mid on.
Bowls it full and on off, Prabath Jayasuriya pushes it to silly mid off.
Short again on middle, Prabath Jayasuriya gets on top of it and blocks it onto the ground.
Starts with a bouncer on middle and leg, Prabath Jayasuriya ducks under it.
Swing and a miss! This is floated on middle, turninga away sharply, Dinesh Chandimal has a wild swing at it but misses it completely.
FOUR! SMASHED! This is tossed up on middle , Dinesh Chandimal goes down and smears it towards deep mid-wicket fence for a boundary.

An appeal for LBW but turned down. This is tossed up on leg, turning in. Dinesh Chandimal leans on to block but misses and gets wrapped around the pads. There is an appeal for LBW but the finger stays down. Babar Azam goes for the review but Ultra Edge shows no bat involved and Ball tracking shows wickets missing. The on-field call remains and Pakistan lose their review.
A bit short on off, Dinesh Chandimal cuts it to deep point.
FOUR! Nice shot! This is floated on middle, Dinesh Chandimal goes down and sweeps it fine towards wide of fine leg. Shaheen Afridi put a desperate dive but could not save the boundary.
Tossed up on leg, turning in, Dinesh Chandimal blocks back to the bowler.
Prabath Jayasuriya survives. This is on a length and on off, Prabath Jayasuriya opens the face and guides it to point.
In the blockhole and on middle, Prabath Jayasuriya does well to dig it back to the bowler.
Full and on middle and leg, Dinesh Chandimal eases it to long on and takes the single this time. Prabath Jayasuriya has two balls to survive.
Slower ball again, on a length and on off, shaping in. Dinesh Chandimal blocks it with his inner half.
Full and wide outside off, Dinesh Chandimal throws his bat at it and outside edges it to third man. No run taken.
Slower delivery, full toss on middle, Dinesh Chandimal nudges it to mid-wicket but denies for the run.
Full again on middle, Prabath Jayasuriya knocks it towards short mid on.
Floated on middle, drifting down the leg, Prabath Jayasuriya misses his flick and the ball hits him on his pads and goes towards fine leg. He wants the single but Dinesh Chandimal says no.
Too full this time on off, Prabath Jayasuriya digs it to mid on.
A bit short outside off, turning away. Dinesh Chandimal cuts it through cover-point for a single.
Tossed up on leg, turning in. Dinesh Chandimal pushes it to square leg.
Floated on leg, Dinesh Chandimal knocks it to mid on.
Prabath Jayasuriya is the last man in for Sri Lanka.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Pakistan have finally managed to strike! Hasan Ali finally gets an edge to carry and get him a wicket! He serves this on a good length and angling into the batter. Maheesh Theekshana gets behind the line of the ball and looks to defend. The ball pitches on middle and straighten to take the outside edge of the bat. Mohammad Rizwan takes an easy catch behind the wicket and Hasan Ali pulls out his trademark celebration to send Maheesh Theekshana on his way. Pakistan have one more wicket to take and will be hoping to bat before end of Day's play!
Commentary.Howout: c Mohammad Rizwan b Hasan Ali

Commentary.Commentary: This one is short and wide outside off, Dinesh Chandimal slashes this to deep backward point for a single.

Dropped! Caught and bowled chance goes begging! Hasan Ali bowls this slightly slower and full in line with the stumps, Dinesh Chandimal hits this uppishly back to the bowler. Hasan Ali gets his hand to it but spills it. This was the chance they had been waiting for! What a miss!
Delivers this on a good length on off, Dinesh Chandimal knocks this back to the bowler.

This one is a fraction full outside off, Dinesh Chandimal looks to drive and gets a bottom edge through to the keeper. Just falls short of Mohammad Rizwan who does not really appeal. The umpires review the catch nonetheless and the replays confirm that it is not out.
Hasan Ali begins with a good length delivery and gets it to nip back in from outside off, Dinesh Chandimal fends this back to the bowler.
Full delivery outside off, Maheesh Theekshana looks to defend this and gets an inside edge towards backward square leg.
Agha Salman pulls the length back and in line with the stumps, Maheesh Theekshana goes on the back foot and defends solidly.
This one is also angled down leg with the turn from a fuller length. Maheesh Theekshana watches this one go.
This turns sharply from middle and goes down leg, Maheesh Theekshana looks to play and misses.
Maheesh Theekshana charges down the pitch and looks to heave a full delivery on his pads, leg side. Misses the ball as it hits his pad.
Agha Salman tosses this one full on middle, Dinesh Chandimal knocks this towards long on for a single.
Beaten! What a delivery! Angles this one in wide from the crease on a good length. Gets the ball the straighten after pitching and beats the bat as it goes over the stumps.
Shaheen Afridi is off the field currently. He is seen with an ice pack near his right knee area.
Serves this full outside off and gets the ball to shape away. Maheesh Theekshana goes for a shot and misses.
Delivers this a fraction short and outside off, Maheesh Theekshana sways out of the way and lets it through.
Hasan Ali continues bowling on a good length outside off, Maheesh Theekshana raises his hands and leaves this alone.
This is served on a good length as well just outside off, Maheesh Theekshana plays inside the line of the ball and gets beaten.
Hasan Ali bowls this on a good length outside off, Dinesh Chandimal taps the left of cover and rushes across for a single.
Tossed up full outside off, Dinesh Chandimal carves this through cover-point for a single.
This is full on middle, Dinesh Chandimal flicks this to mid-wicket.
Tossed up full on off, Maheesh Theekshana opens the face of his bat and works it towards deep point for a single.
Agha Salmancomes down the wicket adn hits the ball on the full back to the bowler.
This one is full and outside off, Maheesh Theekshana plays for the turn and gets beaten on the outside edge as the ball goes through straight.
Agha Salman begins with a full delivery angled into the pads, Dinesh Chandimal looks to work this through mid-wicket but gets an inside edge towards backward square leg for a single.
Agha Salman (14-1-49-0) comes into the attack and replaces Mohammad Nawaz.
Targets the stumps this time. Theekshana stays back to keep it out.
Fuller ball, outside off, little bit of away swing. Theekshana looks for a big booming drive but misses.
Outside off again, cut to deep point for one.
A length ball, outside off, stays a bit low. Chandimal looks to cut but bottom edges it on the deck.
Overpitched and outside off, driven to covers.
This is full and on off. Played back to the bowler.
Drinks! Dinesh Chandimal has scored a brilliant half-century and Sri Lanka have taken their lead past 300 now. Pakistan took one wicket but have been unable to dislodge the tail of Sri Lanka.
Flatter and on off. Theekshana again makes a solid block.
On middle, blocked out.
Bye! Very full and sliding down the leg side. Chandimal fails to sweep. The ball hits Rizwan on his knee and rolls behind to fine leg. He looks a bit in pain but ready to continue.
On off, pushed through covers for a single.
Tossed up nicely, angling around middle and off. Theekshana prods to defend but might have got an inside edge there.
Shorter and outside off, slower. Chandimal punches it through covers for one.
Chandimal will keep the strike. Fuller and nips back in on off, it is pushed to mid off for a quick single.
On a length and outside off, this one straightens up. Chandimal is not fully through as he tries to defend, misses it.
The lead gets past the 300 mark! Same delivery as the previous one. Chandimal flicks it in the vacant deep mid-wicket region for a couple. Shah need to drag his length ball.
A yorker but sliding down, whipped behind square on the leg side for a couple.
FOUR! That is a gorgeous shot! Chandimal anticipated the line to be full and he drives with the swing through the line and past mid on, to his left for a boundary.
Full ball, around off and swinging in. Chandimal watchfully pushes it to mid off.
Flighted full and around middle. Blocked out.
Goes wide of the crease and serves a full ball on off. Theekshana pushes it to covers.
Keeps bowling onto the stumps. Theekshana stays back to defend.
Shorter and on middle. Blocked out.
Slows it up, flatter and angling on the pads. Theekshana seems to miss his flick. It lobs off the pads in the hands of short leg. An appeal follows but nothing given.
Tossed up, sliding on middle.  Theekshana pushes it to covers.
Sharp single! Full ball with sharp inward shape, on middle. Theekshana pushes it to mid off and calls for a quick single. Afridi has a shy at the keeper's end but misses.
On a length and on off, nips in. Chandimal adjusts quickly as he drops it to covers. One.
An inswinging fuller ball on middle. Theekshana lofts it over the bowler's head. Afridi from mid off makes a tumbling stop. One.
A length ball, around off and it swings back in very late. Theekshana gets hit on the pads as he tries to fend it away.
Just after two balls Pakistan change their mind and take the new ball.
Length ball, outside off. Chandimal pushes it off the outer half to point for one.
On a length and outside off. Chandimal punches it to covers.
The second new ball is available now. Pakistan have chosen not to take it yet.
Slower through the air on off, Maheesh Theekshana opens the face of his bat and guides it towards third man for a brace.
Floated on off again, Maheesh Theekshana defends it to silly point.
On off, kept out.
Well left! This is tossed up again on middle and off, turning away. Maheesh Theekshana watches it and leaves it alone.
Tossed up on middle, turning away. Dinesh Chandimal works it through mid-wicket for a run.
Floated on middle, Dinesh Chandimal blocks it with his inner half to the leg side.
Good delivery this time. This is short again on middle, angling into the body. Maheesh Theekshana does well to move out of the way and lets it go the keeper.
Short ball again on off, angling away a bit. Maheesh Theekshana tries to cut it but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Bangs in a bouncer on leg, Maheesh Theekshana ducks under it.

Another half-century for Dinesh Chandimal. He is in some form. This is on a length and on off, Dinesh Chandimal knocks it with soft hands to covers for a single. Dinesh Chandimal once again is the man for Sri Lanka and he has looked like he is playing on a different pitch. He will look to score as many runs as possible and extend the lead.
Good length on off, shaping in, Dinesh Chandimal blocks it with the bottom part of his willow onto the ground. The ball hits the ground and then goes onto hit him on the chest.
Starts with a bouncer again but down the leg, Dinesh Chandimal ducks underneath it.
Flatter and quicker on leg, Dinesh Chandimal flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
BEATEN!! This is bowled slower through the air on middle, turning away. Dinesh Chandimal gets forward to block but gets beaten on the inside edge.
Floated on off, Dinesh Chandimal blocks it ut.
Full again on middle, Dinesh Chandimal knocks it to silly mid off.
Floated on middle, Maheesh Theekshana pushes it towards cover-point for on.
Slower through the air outside off, turnin away a bit too much. Maheesh Theekshana leaves it alone.
Full again on middle and off, Maheesh Theekshana goes to drive it to mid off but gets an inside edge and the ball rolls towards mid on. They cross.
Serves this full and down the leg, Maheesh Theekshana works it to mid-wicket.
Short again on leg, angling away. Dinesh Chandimal pulls it to fine leg for one.
Goes full this time on off, Maheesh Theekshana drives it gently to mid off and picks up a single.
Back of a length delivery on off, Dinesh Chandimal cuts it close to his body towards deep point for a single.
Bangs in a short ball around off, Dinesh Chandimal ducks under it.
On middle, blocked out.
Slower through the air on middle, turning in. Maheesh Theekshana once again is solid in his defense.
Quicker and flatter on middle, Maheesh Theekshana knocks it back to the bowler.
Full and on middle, Maheesh Theekshana blocks it out.
Maheesh Theekshana gets off the mark, This is tossed up on off, Maheesh Theekshana pushes it through covers for a comfortable brace.

Good running between the wickets here. This is floated on middle, turning away. Dinesh Chandimal waits for the ball and guides to the vacant third man area. The fielder gives a chase but the batters run three.
This is short as well and better directed. Maheesh Theekshana gets low under this delivery and lets it through to the keeper.
This one is on a good length and outside off, Maheesh Theekshana knocks this towards cover.
Naseem Shah bangs this one in short and in line with the stumps. Maheesh Theekshana does not even need to duck under this one but wide has no been called.

This is served on a good length outside off, Maheesh Theekshana is drawn into a shot and gets a thick edge that falls just short of gully. Maheesh Theekshana needs to apply himself here and get Dinesh Chandimal on strike.
NO BALL! Serves this one fuller outside off, Dinesh Chandimal strokes this to deep cover-point for a single. He has overstepped though and a no ball has been called!
On a good length once again and just outside off, Dinesh Chandimal looks to defend and gets an inside edge onto his foot.
Naseem Shah starts off with a good length delivery outside off, Dinesh Chandimal defends this towards cover.
Naseem Shah comes into the attack for the first time in this innings in place of Mohammad Nawaz.
Yasir Shah continues to bowl full and this is on off, Maheesh Theekshana taps it back towards the bowler.
This one is flighted full on middle, Maheesh Theekshana fends it back to the bowler.
Serves this one full and wide outside off. The turn takes it further away and Maheesh Theekshana lets it go.
Yasir Shah goes full once again and closer to the stumps. Maheesh Theekshana taps it towards point and looks for a single that is not there.
Flights this one full and well outside off. Maheesh Theekshana leaves this one alone.
This is served full and pitching on middle, Dinesh Chandimal nudges it towards backward square leg for a single.
Tossed up again on middle, Maheesh Theekshana plays a solid defense on the off side.
Tossed up on off, Maheesh Theekshana blocks it towards short mid off.
Maheesh Theekshana comes out to the middle.

OUT! BOWLED! The off pole has been pegged back here! A five wicket haul for Mohammad Nawaz and he breaks this stubborn partnership! This is a fraction short outside off and comes in sharply. Ramesh Mendis looks to make room to cut but the ball is too close to his body goes on to hit the top of off stump! That is the first five wicket haul for Mohammad Nawaz in Test cricket!
Full delivery outside off, Ramesh Mendis strides forward and defends this towards short cover.
This is full and on middle, Ramesh Mendis clips this towards mid-wicket.
Mohammad Nawaz serves this short and outside off, Ramesh Mendis defends on his back foot towards mid off.
Flights this full outside off, Dinesh Chandimal punches this straight to cover.
Shorter in length and angling into the pads, Ramesh Mendis clips this towards deep square leg for single.
This is also short and turning wide from off stump, Dinesh Chandimal uses the crease and works this through cover-point for a single.

FOUR! In the air and runs away for a boundary! This is tossed up full and outside off, Dinesh Chandimal slaps this over the cover fielder and gets four runs! Dinesh Chandimal is balancing defense with some attack!
This is short and turning wide outside off, Ramesh Mendis hits this on his back foot to the left of cover for a single.
Yasir Shah begins with a full delivery outside off, Dinesh Chandimal works this to the right of point for a single.
Yasir Shah (23-2-93-3) to bowl from the other end.
Mohammad Nawaz continues bowling full outside off, Dinesh Chandimal taps this towards cover-point and rushes across for a single.
Tossed up full outside off, This one is defended towards mid off by Dinesh Chandimal.
Mohammad Nawaz flights this full on middle and leg, Dinesh Chandimal defends this back to the bowler.
Mohammad Nawaz goes short and wide outside off, Ramesh Mendis stands tall and punches this to deep cover for a single.
This is flighted full outside off, Ramesh Mendis watches the ball go straight into the keeper's gloves.
Mohammad Nawaz begins with a full delivery outside off, Ramesh Mendis strokes this towards point.

We are set to resume action and Pakistan players walk onto the field aiming to claim these remaining three wickets. Dinesh Chandimal walks out and Sri Lanka will be hoping Ramesh Mendis will be able to support him and take them to a challenging score. Mohammad Nawaz to begin proceedings with the ball.
... Day 3, Session 3...

Sri Lanka lost a few wickets but they are still ahead in the game as they lead by 261 runs. Dinesh Chandimal once again showed his class and is still on the pitch along with Ramesh Mendis who has supported him well. Although they lost wickets at regular intervals, they scored at a good rate. This is the first session in this match where 100 runs have been scored. Sri Lanka will look to extend the lead past 300 now. Join us back in a bit for the last session.

Mohammad Nawaz and Yasir Shah spun a web around the Sri Lankan batters as they picked up 5 wickets among themselves in this session. They have been consistent in their line and lengths and got the reward. They will look to bowl out Sri Lanka under 300 now but it will not come easy as Dinesh Chandimal again looks in a good rhythm and is showing a counterattacking approach as well.

The Lunch break helped Pakistan mightily. They came in this session looking a completely different team that played in the first session. They picked up wickets at regular intervals and did not let the Lankan batters settle in. Sri Lanka will not be happy with themselves as they could not capitalize on the partnership built by Kusal Mendis and Oshada Fernando. They got the wicket of Fernando on the second ball after the session began and since then they were quite impressive.
A single to end the over and the session as well! Shorter and outside off, cut away to deep point for one. That will be Tea as well!
Drops it short and way outside off. Mendis opens the face of the bat and dabs it past first slip and to third man for a brace.
A loopy ball on off. Mendis blocks it out on the front foot.
Short again. It is slapped to deep point for a run.
Tossed up, around off and turning in. Mendis tries to defend but this one spins sharply and hits him on the pads. An appeal but it was sliding down.
FOUR! Azam starts with shorter ball, outside off and spinning in. Mendis punches hard off the back foot and to deep cover for a boundary. 250 up for the Lankans.
Better from Nawaz! Length ball, outside off, angling in and spins away. Chandimal lunges to defend but misses comprehensively.
Angles a full ball from wide of the crease. Chandimal hangs back and keeps it out.
Slides one down the leg side. Mendis sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
Flatter and outside off. Left alone.
This is full and Mendis pushes it to covers.
Fuller ball on off. Blocked out.
Tossed up full and on middle, Ramesh Mendis clips this towards deep backward square leg for a single.
Full outside off, Ramesh Mendis fends this towards the cover region.
FOUR! Ramesh Mendis gets his first boundary! This one is a fraction short and angled into the stumps, Ramesh Mendis rocks back and pulls this through mid-wicket fora boundary!
This is full and outside off, a leggie. Left alone.
On off, blocked out.
Full ball, just outside off, swept to deep square leg for a couple of runs.
Fuller ball, slanting around off. Chandimal prods and blocks it.
Angles a full ball on off, pushed back to the bowler.
Shorter and again extra bounce. Mendis works it through covers for a run.
This is short and outside off, no turn. Mendis tries to defend in the wrong line.
An arm ball, slanting on leg. Chandimal tucks it to deep mid-wicket for a single. Mohammad Rizwan looks a bit in pain as the ball bounces and hits him near his right arm and deflects onto the throat.
Flighted full, outside off, driven to covers.
Slows it up, on middle, pushed to long off for a run.
Tossed up, outside off. Mendis steps down and across to sweep it to deep square leg for one.
Slightly short and outside off. Chandimal punches it to deep cover for one.
Too full and on off. Defended on the front foot.
A leggie, lands on leg and spins around off. Chandimal reads it well as he blocks off the back foot.
Tossed up, on off, defended to covers.

Darts this one down the leg, Ramesh Mendis misses his sweep and the ball goes straight and hits the keeper's pad and goes up in the air, Mohammad Rizwan tries to grab it but fails to do so. Mohammad Nawaz thinks that the batter got a glove on it and is dissappointed the catch is not completed.

On middle, blocked out.

Ramesh Mendis is the new batter in.

OUT! DRAGGED ON! Mohammad Nawaz gets his fourth. This is floated outside off, spinning in. Niroshan Dickwella tries the reverse sweep again but only manages an inside edge. The ball hits the ground and goes onto hit the leg stump. Sri Lanka in huge trouble now.
Slower through the air on middle, Dinesh Chandimal guides to point from his back foot for a run.
Tossed up on off, Niroshan Dickwella blocks it out.

FOUR! Beautifully played. This is quicker and flatter on middle, Niroshan Dickwella again sweeps it hard towards deep square leg. The fielder misjudges and dives early to his right. The ball goes past him and races away to the boundary.
This is short outside off, Dinesh Chandimal cuts it through cover-point for another single.
Floated on middle, turning in, Niroshan Dickwella goes down and sweeps it fin towards backward square for a single.
A bit short on leg, Dinesh Chandimal stays back and punches it to long off for one.
Tossed up on middle, Dinesh Chandimal blocks it to the off side.
FOUR! Clever from Niroshan Dickwella. This floated on off, Niroshan Dickwella plays the reverse sweep past the first slip fielder towards the third man fence for a boundary.
Tossed up on off, Niroshan Dickwella gets forwards and knocks it towards mid on.
Slightly shorter outside off, turning away. Dinesh Chandimal dabs it past cover-point for a single.
Flatter delivery outside off, no turn. Dinesh Chandimal leaves it alone.
Tossed up on middle, Dinesh Chandimal blocks it down the pitch.
Tossed up on off, Niroshan Dickwella goes down for the sweep and gets a top edge towards backward square leg. They cross.
Tossed up on leg, Niroshan Dickwella revers sweeps it towards deep point for a single.
Arm ball on middle and leg, Dinesh Chandimal flicks it of his back foot to square leg for one.
Full on middle, Niroshan Dickwella sweeps it to deep square leg for one. He gets off the mark.
Floated on off, Niroshan Dickwella goes for the sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Darts this one on leg, Niroshan Dickwella tries to play but gets hit on the pads.
Niroshan Dickwella comes in.

OUT! CLEANED UP! Yasir Shah bowls this a bit quicker and full on middle, holds its line and skidding onto the stumps. Dhananjaya de Silva goes on the back foot to block but plays down the wrong line. The ball brushes his front pad and goes crashing onto the stumps. Yasir Shah once again getting the wicket. Sri Lanka are six down now.
Slightly shorter outside off, Dinesh Chandimal cuts it hard to point and calls for a single. There is a misfield and the batters scampers across for the second as well.
Tossed up on off, turning away a bit. Dinesh Chandimal knocks it towards point.
Flighted delivery on off, turning away. Dinesh Chandimal guides it to point.
Short again outide off, Dhananjaya de Silva works it to deep point for a single.
A bit short around off, Dinesh Chandimal pushes it through cover-point for one.
SIX! HUGE! This tossed up on middle, Dinesh Chandimal smokes it over the deep mid-wicket fence for a biggie. This is brilliant batting from him.
Sharp turn from outside off, Dhananjaya de Silva leaves this one alone.
Yasir Shah has been a touch too short this over as this one is pitching on off and turning further away. Dhananjaya de Silva thumps it through to deep cover for a couple of runs.
Short and wide outside off, Dhananjaya de Silva looks to guide this towards third man but hits it straight to gully.
This one is served full and in line with the stumps, Dhananjaya de Silva flicks the ball through mid-wicket for a brace.

FOUR! This is a gift once again! Yasir Shah serves this short and wide outside off. Dhananjaya de Silva waits on it and cuts it late past backward point for a boundary to third man! These are easy runs on a difficult wicket!
Yasir Shah slights this full on outside off, Dinesh Chandimal strokes this towards mid off.
Mohammad Nawaz serves this full and going down leg, Dinesh Chandimal sweeps hard and hits the shin of leg slip and rolls to deep backward square leg for a single.
This one is quicker in the air served short and outside off, Dinesh Chandimal looks to slash at this and gets beaten by the extra bounce.

SIX! Sri Lanka are choosing to counterattack now! This one is served full and angling into the pads, Dinesh Chandimal gets on his knee and swats it towards deep mid-wicket for another big hit! Sri Lanka are not going to block around and wait for an unplayable delivery!
Mohammad Nawaz flights this full outside off, Dinesh Chandimal taps it towards cover.
Full and angling down leg, Dinesh Chandimal sweeps and the ball hits the pad and lobs up to Mohammad Rizwan behind the wicket.
Mohammad Nawaz delivers this full and in line with the stumps. Dinesh Chandimal defends this back down the pitch.

Beaten! Good flight from Yasir Shah as he serves this full outside off, Dhananjaya de Silva pushes at the ball and misses the line completely. Beats the outside edge and is collected well by the keeper.

SIX! That is one way to negotiate spin! Dhananjaya de Silva gets down the wicket and catches the ball on the full in line with the stumps. This one flies high and handsome over the long off boundary for a biggie! Dhananjaya de Silva is taking the attack to Yasir Shah!
This is full outside off, Dhananjaya de Silva fends this towards point.
Yasir Shah serves that full outside off, Dhananjaya de Silva taps it towards cover and looks for a single. Dinesh Chandimal sends him back.
Goes full outside leg, Dinesh Chandimal sweeps this towards fine leg for a single. The players appeal but that has come off the gloves.
Yasir Shah looks in good rhythm! Getting some good turn now from this wicket. Serves this full outside leg and gets the ball to turn past the outside edge. Well collected by the keeper.

Drinks! An excellent session for Pakistan till now. They have got rid of the set batters and the spinners are finding a bit of rhythm as well. It will get a lot tougher to bat as the game progresses and Pakistan have a chance to make more inroads.
Shorter in length and pitching on off, Dhananjaya de Silva rocks back and punches it towards cover.

Mohammad Nawaz floats this full and angling down leg, Dhananjaya de Silva looks to sweep and misses. Hits the pads and the Pakistan players appeal! The umpire reckons it is going down leg. They do not review.

Yasir Shah serves a googly full and outside off, Dhananjaya de Silva reads the delivery and defends solidly.

This is short as well, and spinning from off, Dhananjaya de Silva works this towards cover-point.

We are back for the post-Lunch session. Pakistan need to execute their plans much better this session. The sun is out, no chance of rain, and a strong breeze is flowing across. Oshada Fernando and Kusal Mendis to resume their innings. Yasir Shah to bowl now.
... Day 3, Session 2 ...

Pakistan on the other hand have been pretty ordinary with their bowling. The spinners struggled to find the right line and lengths consistently. But whenever they did, they troubled the batters as this pitch has something to offer. Pakistan probably needed this break so that they can revisit their plans and execute them better. They would hope to get a breakthrough soon after Lunch or else this partnership could take the game away from them pretty quickly. Join us back after the break for the second session.

Sri Lanka lost their night watchman pretty quickly at the start of the day. But that didn't affect them much as Kusal Mendis and Oshada Fernando have scored runs at a good rate and built a really good partnership. Oshada Fernando scored his half-century and Kusal Mendis looks set too. The batters put away the bad deliveries and defended others with confidence. They will look to continue this and increase the lead as much as possible.

This session has belonged to Sri Lanka even though they lost a wicket early. Pakistan have been very inconsistent with their bowling and allowed the Lankan batters to build a partnership. Kusal Mendis and Oshada Fernando have added 91 runs. This could hurt Pakistan big time. Sri Lanka lead by 136 runs and are looking very comfortable.

Serves this full outside off, Kusal Mendis lunges forward to defend towards point.

PITCH REPORT - Russel Arnold is pitchside. He says the pace will be key for the bowlers. Adds that the batters need to survive the new ball and try to play on the back foot and avoid the straight ones. Feels the runs will come when the ball will get older. Saqlain Mustaq, the head coach of Pakistan is up for a chat. He says they are in a really good position. The confidence is sky high and the players are confident as well. Applauds the knock of Babar Azam and says he is a class player, credit goes to him for the way he played. Adds his players are playing with positive intent and playing with a lot of energy.

At one stage it looked like Pakistan will concede a lead of more than 100 easily but Pakistan's shining star, Babar Azam kept his cool when wickets were falling on the other end and played brilliantly with the tail-enders. Too early to call but that could prove to be the turning point in this match. Now it is time for the hosts to bat well and at least take the score to around 250. It will not come easy though against a fiery bowling lineup. Stay tuned for further updates.

Hello and welcome to the action of Day 3 between Sri Lanka and Pakistan. The match is evenly balanced at this stage as Babar Azam's century and his vital stand with the last two wickets have almost cut out the Lankan's first innings lead. In reply, Pakistan bowlers managed to get a lone wicket in a small passage of overs, that of the opposition skipper. Kasun Rajitha came as a night watchman and did his work but Pakistan will hope to dominate the first hour of play.
... Day 3, Session 1 ...

By no means it was a good batting performance if you remove a couple of scenarios in that Pakistan scoreboard. They were 112/8 as no one dominated against Sri Lanka's spin web. It was Babar Azam's heroics and great understanding of the tail, which has helped Pakistan keep things equal at this point of the game. Prabath Jayasuriya was again the showman with the ball, claiming his third consecutive five-fer while Maheesh Theekshana and Ramesh Mendis ended with a couple each. If they had taken the last two wickets, it would have been a superb outing for Sri Lanka. Now Day 3 which is known as the 'moving day' will give us a  slight glimpse of who controls the game more. Do join us for the action at 10 am IST (4.30 am GMT). Do join us for the build up as well. You can follow the match between England vs India which is currently going on and is a decider as well. Switch the tabs for the action. From here, it is a goodbye!

It would have been a completely different scenario if the hosts didn't let the Pakistani tail wag but a fantastic hundred from the main man, Babar Azam along with a record last wicket partnership with Naseem Shah saw Pakistan almost cut out the deficit completely. It was all even and after that Sri Lanka in reply, scored runs at a brisk pace but lost Karunaratne in the process. The night watchman, Kasun Rajitha has done his job to watch out for a few balls. He and Oshada Fernando will hope for a good start on Day 3.

Another exciting day in this match comes to an end! Sri Lanka have lost their skipper in what was a small passage to play with the bat and now they lead by 40 runs. Still, a long way to go but Pakistan will be the happier side after the way Day 2 went.
